# Artifisio icons registry

> Free, open-licensed icons (CC-BY-4.0) as plain files plus a versioned manifest. Install with the `artifisio` CLI or fetch files straight from the CDN. No account, no runtime dependency.

- Manifest: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/artifisio/icons/main/manifest.json (schemaVersion 2, registryVersion 2026.10.05-1735-cbf8220)
- Registry index across kinds: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/artifisio/icons/main/index.json
- CDN file pattern: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/artifisio/icons@main/sets/<set>/<file>
- Install: `npx artifisio add <set> --kind icon` (writes files + ATTRIBUTION.md)
- Search: `npx artifisio search "<query>" --kind icon --json`
- License: LICENSE in this repo; attribution string is in every set's `license.attribution`.

## Sets (15)

- [Petroglyph Trail](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/petroglyph-trail): An outdoors family pecked into stone — rock-art stick figures, side-profile animals, spirals and chipped edges, even on a compass or backpack. (62 icons; tags: petroglyph, outdoors, primitive, solid)
- [Linocut Market](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/linocut-market): A farmers'-market family carved from lino — bold black silhouettes cut through with tapered white gouge marks and hand-cut edges. (62 icons; tags: linocut, food, handmade, solid)
- [Housemates](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/housemates): A kawaii household icon family — chubby rounded outlines, and every object wears a tiny face that smiles, winks or blushes. (62 icons; tags: kawaii, home, cute, outline)
- [Kitchen Alchemy](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/kitchen-alchemy-ii): Cooking tools drawn as an alchemist's apparatus — a dark line drawing with one warm accent on the liquid, flame or spark. (14 icons; tags: kitchen, cooking, whimsical, duotone)
- [Bitmap](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/bitmap-3): The core UI set rendered on a coarse pixel lattice — whole square pixels only, staircase diagonals, not one curve in the family. (34 icons; tags: pixel, retro, lo-fi, solid)
- [Gaffer](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/gaffer-2): Every icon torn from tape and pressed down by hand — straight strips at crooked angles, ragged ends and honest overlaps. (33 icons; tags: tape, collage, handmade, duotone)
- [Bitmap](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/bitmap-2): The core UI set rendered on a coarse pixel lattice — whole square pixels only, staircase diagonals, not one curve in the family. (34 icons; tags: pixel, retro, lo-fi, solid)
- [Pulse](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/pulse): A calm rounded outline family for health products — anatomy, clinics, diagnostics, fitness and everyday wellbeing. (142 icons; tags: health, medical, wellness, outline)
- [Constellation](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/constellation): A night-atlas icon family charted rather than drawn — every glyph is a constellation of bright star-dots joined by thin chart lines, for astronomy, sleep and wonder products. (142 icons; tags: stars, night, celestial, outline)
- [Stack](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/stack): An engineered outline icon family for developer, cloud and data products — code, infrastructure, networking, pipelines, devops and hardware. (141 icons; tags: developer, cloud, data, outline)
- [Cross Stitch · GPT Image 2](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/cross-stitch-gpt2): A cosy home icon family sewn rather than drawn — every contour is a running line of stitches on an implied fabric weave. (34 icons; tags: embroidery, stitch, cosy, outline, gpt2)
- [Whiskers](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/whiskers): A pet-app icon family where every single glyph has quietly grown a cat part — ears, a tail, a paw or whiskers. (34 icons; tags: cat, pets, playful, outline, gpt2)
- [Meltdown · GPT Image 2](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/meltdown-gpt2): A UI icon family caught mid-melt — every glyph sags, pools and drips, for festival, summer and heatwave products. (34 icons; tags: melting, liquid, playful, ui, gpt2)
- [Drafting Table · Nano Banana 2 (Flash)](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/drafting-table-nb2): An engineering icon set drawn as a CAD detail — each part sits inside its own centre lines, extension lines and dimension arrows. (34 icons; tags: blueprint, technical, engineering, duotone, nb2)
- [UI Essentials](https://github.com/artifisio/icons/tree/main/sets/ui-essentials): A geometric outline icon family covering the core UI vocabulary — navigation, actions, media, commerce and more. (98 icons; tags: ui, outline, essentials)
